title: spec build: build-schemas.ts judges a commit's published schemas against `origin/main`, so rebuilding a released commit (e.g. the 18.0.0-next.3 one) from a clone with a newer `origin/main` fails — not reproducible
body:
**Filing gate ①, class (a): a named producer fails.** From the out-of-scope findings of the objectui#12957 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12963), re-read by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`) at objectstack `main` `e4bcced0b4`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What happened

objectui now builds `@objectstack/*` from the objectstack commit its `.objectstack-sha` pins (ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955). Its first pin is `2c9bf9430a`, the commit `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` was released from.

On PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12963 at `db2b7239`, 13 of 25 CI jobs failed to build that commit's spec. The error was `2 schema(s) left the published set with no registered removal (#4725)`, naming `json-schema/api/PackageInstallManifest.json` and `json-schema/ui/PageRecordBinding.json`.

Those two schemas were added on `main` *after* `next.3`. The build anchors its disappearance ratchet on `merge-base(HEAD, origin/main)` (`packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`, documented from `:263`). So a clone whose `origin/main` is newer than the commit being built judges that commit against schemas it never had. The fetch the dev cites is at `:2466`.

**Effect:** a released commit's spec build depends on the clone's remote state, not only on the commit. objectui works around it by removing the remote after fetching the pin (objectui#12963). The same happens to any rebuild of an older commit: a bisect, a release re-cut, or cloud's own builds at its `.objectstack-sha`.

## What a fix has to satisfy (for the spec lane to design)

Building commit X gives the same verdict whatever `origin/main` points at. For example, the ratchet anchors only when HEAD is ahead of the last release, or it is skipped outside this repository's own CI.

**Dedupe:** a REST read of this repository's issues updated since 2026-10-17, grepped for `build-schemas`, `origin/main`, `reproducible`, `PageRecordBinding` and `#4725`. No hit is this defect.
